message:
the pattern read 6 of the 7 decorators the TypeScript parser holds, and not these:
      libs/components/widget/src/badge.ts:4
$reason: A component declared inside a namespace, its decorator indented as prettier indents it there. ngc compiles it and its template's part reaches `consts` (measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker); the pattern wants the decorator in column zero and reads none. The parser counts decorators at every depth of a file, so the count holds one the pattern did not read; a count that does not descend into a namespace would agree with the pattern, and the case would pass every point. `decorator-in-a-function` holds the other nesting, a function's body.
